  exit 127
fi

    fi
  done
  command claude "$@"
}

bin_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd -P)
current=$(cat "$bin_dir/current" 2>/dev/null)
binary="$bin_dir/versions/$current/bcct"
if [ -z "$current" ] || [ ! -x "$binary" ]; then
  echo 'bcct: no installed version found. Run: npx better-claude-code-telegram' >&2
  echo 'bcct: nenhuma versão instalada encontrada. Rode: npx better-claude-code-telegram' >&2
  exit 127
fi
exec "$binary" "$@"

app/shell.sh.content:
claude() {
  local arg
  for arg in "$@"; do
    if [ "$arg" = "--telegram" ]; then
      '{root}/app/bin/bcct' launch "$@"
      return
    fi
  done
  command claude "$@"
}

app/bin/bcct.content:
#!/bin/sh
bin_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd -P)
current=$(cat "$bin_dir/current" 2>/dev/null)
binary="$bin_dir/versions/$current/bcct"
if [ -z "$current" ] || [ ! -x "$binary" ]; then
  echo 'bcct: no installed version found. Run: npx better-claude-code-telegram' >&2
  echo 'bcct: nenhuma versão instalada encontrada. Rode: npx better-claude-code-telegram' >&2
  exit 127
fi
exec "$binary" "$@"

app/shell.sh.content:
claude() {
  local arg
  for arg in "$@"; do
    if [ "$arg" = "--telegram" ]; then
      '{root}/app/bin/bcct' launch "$@"
      return
    fi
  done
  command claude "$@"
}

app/bin/bcct.content:
#!/bin/sh
bin_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd -P)
current=$(cat "$bin_dir/current" 2>/dev/null)
binary="$bin_dir/versions/$current/bcct"
if [ -z "$current" ] || [ ! -x "$binary" ]; then
  echo 'bcct: no installed version found. Run: npx better-claude-code-telegram' >&2
  echo 'bcct: nenhuma versão instalada encontrada. Rode: npx better-claude-code-telegram' >&2
  exit 127
fi
exec "$binary" "$@"

files.app/shell.sh:
claude() {
  local arg
  for arg in "$@"; do
    if [ "$arg" = "--telegram" ]; then
      '{root}/app/bin/bcct' launch "$@"
      return
    fi
  done
  command claude "$@"
}

bin_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd -P)
current=$(cat "$bin_dir/current" 2>/dev/null)
binary="$bin_dir/versions/$current/bcct"
if [ -z "$current" ] || [ ! -x "$binary" ]; then
  echo 'bcct: no installed version found. Run: npx better-claude-code-telegram' >&2
  echo 'bcct: nenhuma versão instalada encontrada. Rode: npx better-claude-code-telegram' >&2
  exit 127
fi
exec "$binary" "$@"

files.app/shell.sh:
claude() {
  local arg
  for arg in "$@"; do
    if [ "$arg" = "--telegram" ]; then
      '{root}/app/bin/bcct' launch "$@"
      return
    fi
  done
  command claude "$@"
}
